senses.nuances: 不能据此将 ow 标为正式马来语词条。英语疼痛感叹词义及 /aʊ/ 读音可见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/ow)，但英语词条不能证明原始 token 的身份。pos 暂用给定枚举中的 particle 容纳感叹功能，实际类别是 interjection。以下搭配为条件性混语示例，未经语料频率验证；正式情境采用引用说明。不能自动把 ow 当作 oh、马来语感叹词、姓氏或缩写。

etymology.historical_story: English ow is a natural exclamation representing a cry of pain. That English history does not establish a Malay origin or prove what this isolated corpus token means. Without its surrounding sentence, the form must remain unresolved. The example dialogue illustrates only the explicitly conditional interpretation as an English exclamation.
